segments.text: Rain drifted through the forest as Mira followed the narrow path toward an old cabin.
Wind moved through the trees, shaking wet leaves above her head.
Her footsteps pressed into the damp earth. Somewhere ahead, a dog barked.
The rain grew heavier, and she began running toward the light in the window.
She stepped onto the wooden porch. The old boards creaked beneath her boots.
Mira pushed the door. Its hinges gave a long creak as it opened.
Inside, a gentle piano melody filled the room. The dog settled beside the warm fireplace.
She closed her eyes and listened, safe indoors while the rain whispered beyond the walls.
